checks.text: With no entries the page shows the heading "Budget Planner", the text "No entries yet", and the three summary lines "Income: $0.00", "Expenses: $0.00" and "Balance: $0.00".

Filling the field labelled "Description" with "Salary" and the field labelled "Amount" with "2500", choosing "Income" in the select labelled "Type" and clicking the button "Add entry" adds a list item that contains "Salary" and "+$2,500.00"; the summary shows "Balance: $2,500.00" and "No entries yet" is gone.

After also adding an entry of Type "Expense" with Description "Rent" and Amount "1200.50", a list item contains "Rent" and "-$1,200.50", and the summary shows "Income: $2,500.00", "Expenses: $1,200.50" and "Balance: $1,299.50".
Clicking "Add entry" with an empty Description, or with an Amount that is empty, 0 or negative, adds no list item and shows the message "Enter a description and an amount greater than 0".

Every list item has a button named "Delete <description>". With the entries Salary 2500 (Income) and Rent 1200.50 (Expense), clicking "Delete Rent" removes that item and the summary shows "Expenses: $0.00" and "Balance: $2,500.00".
When expenses exceed income the balance is negative: Income "Gift" 100 and Expense "Bike" 250 show "Balance: -$150.00".
After adding Salary 2500 (Income), reloading the page still shows the list item with "Salary" and "+$2,500.00" and the summary line "Balance: $2,500.00".
